WEEK 8 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Charles, 163.9-160.4 (NAIL-BITER); Adam def. Ryan, 117.0-107.2; Brent def. Drew, 137.5-70.4 (BLOWOUT); Wingard def. Fronge, 139.5-109.5; Jake def. Shaq, 148.9-137.5; Kevin def. Mitchum, 101.5-84.5

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: Drew vs Kevin is 3.9-0.0 and Atlas is somehow the team with points on the board. 0-16, folks. Zero wins all season. Kevin will be fine but I am logging this as one of those footnotes the Ledger loves.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: I took Charles. I took Charles in week 9 against a 7-9 team with no 2027 picks and a Havana return address and Fronge is up 14-0. My lock record is 2-0 on the season so do not even start with me — this is a one-game blip on a resume that speaks for itself.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: TERRENCE IS AT 5-7 AND HE PICKED WINGARD. WINGARD HAS ZERO POINTS. ADAM IS ON THE BOARD AT 25.5 AFTER SPENDING THE WEEK ACQUIRING EVERY BACKUP QUARTERBACK AVAILABLE IN THE STATE OF MINNESOTA. I CANNOT HELP HIM. NO ONE CAN HELP HIM.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Corbishley is live against Ryan right now — 0.0-5.6, Ryan with the early lead — and the defending champion has not beaten Apex this season. That is the number. APEX at $136.58, Ryan's desk sliding to $116.80, and the champion is currently losing the week-9 open. The desk never panics but I am watching this one closely.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: For the third time since I posted rankings: I ranked Fronge eighth, not ninth, not tenth. Down two from sixth because they lost both results and are 7-9 with zero 2027 picks. The roster grade has held. If Charles can't close this out tonight the board can argue about whether Fronge deserved seventh, but eighth was not generous — it was accurate.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Someone needs to give me a segment on Kevin. Third in the standings at 12-4, $102.71 on the exchange up 6.4%, Gardner Minshew added for $98 FAAB three days ago to shore up the QB depth, and Redline is currently on the board against Drew. The recovery narrative that kept stalling has a pulse and nobody has booked the desk time to talk about it.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Jake cut Najee Harris two days ago, is currently leading Brent 18.6-0.0, and EchoPoint is sitting at $94.79 barely touched on the issue. The Ledger is going to need a full accounting of what that backfield looks like for the stretch run once tonight's RB deployment numbers come in.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Kevin last week — 101.5-84.5, clean — and I have Kevin again this week. Drew is 0-16 and has 3.9 points on the board right now, so yes, technically Atlas is leading, but I called this game, my lock record is 1-1, and the season record is 7-5 for a reason.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Mitchum vs Shaq is the last matchup without a live score and I want everyone to notice what is sitting underneath that silence: Deepwater at $101.05 and bleeding, Monarch at $92.17 and climbing, and two teams knotted at 8-8 and 8-8 in the bubble conversation. That first score tonight sets the entire second-half narrative for both franchises.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Ryan is up 5.6-0.0 on Corbishley in the early going and I know exactly how much that is worth: nothing, it is the first quarter, and Apex went 163.9 last week against the best team in the league. My pick stands and I am not adjusting my posture based on five points.
